title: Cartoon Bounce lab 2 (source of the round-2 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-2 Cartoon Bounce templates were built and verified in: speech bubble, button press, rigged character hop, sticker burst, end card, ribbon lower third, rigged hanging sign and bouncy list.
use_when: You want to see a round-2 cartoon template or a working parent rig (pivot at the feet or a nail) before using it, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py.
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg".
Clip ids are unique per comp (csb_, cbp_, cch_, csk_, cec_, crl_, chs_, cbl_).
Rigs: children are parented (parentId) to a visible pivot (Feet, Nail) and their stored positions are offsets from the comp centre.
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/cartoon_bounce_lab2.py writes the comps; apply its PRESETS with preset.apply, then edit.save.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
